evidence: Diagnosis from existing output, no new runs. CM1: one realization of the sea box's third lunar day on its 6 km grid (3-D output every 3 hours, 59 snapshots a quarter) and the three night-test boxes at 6, 3 and 2 km (6-hourly, 7 snapshots each from hour 12), every one with CM1's boundary-layer scheme and 111 levels about 0.5-0.7 km apart in the night's cloud layer; the entrainment is the resolved clouds' bulk rate on those grids, a measurement of the model, and the resampling range treats 3-hourly snapshots as independent. The plume is a bulk-plume calculation on mean soundings. GCM: 3-day means and one-step snapshots of the convection's heating at the end of each mean, five years of the rh 0.7 branch at its six sea cells; the scheme's decision on the means is the tested Python copy run at once, and the running scheme's tops come from its heating at single steps.
reading_rule: cm1.periods: by quarter of the lunar day at the site (hour angle from noon: night -180 to -90, morning -90 to 0, afternoon 0 to 90, evening 90 to 180). samples: cloud (cloud water and ice at least 0.01 g/kg), updraft (cloud rising), core (cloudy updraft lighter than its level's mean in density potential temperature), each against every other point of its level; levels with at least 50 pooled points below 40 km: area share, w, buoyancy (K), mass flux (kg/m2/s), qt and h less the environment's, entrainment from qt and h and detrainment from qt (per metre); bulk: the mass-flux-weighted mean below 16 km, with the 5-95% range over 300 resamplings of the snapshots. cloud_tops: the top of each column's lowest unbroken cloud below 40 km, pooled. plumes: by environment (the quarter's mean sounding), a plume from the lowest 0.5 km mixed, undiluted to its condensation level, then mixing eps_per_m; reversible keeps its condensate as weight, pseudo_adiabatic drops it; cap is the first height above its free-convection level where its buoyancy vanishes, None where it is buoyant nowhere above condensation. eps per e-folding of pressure is eps per metre times eps_per_efolding_at_270k (m). gcm.running_scheme_steps: the convection's heating at the last step of each mean, by quarter of that step; raining where its column integral forms more than 0.05 mm/day; by_top, the highest heated layer (index top first, its mean height). decision_on_means: sbm.column at rh 0.7 without mixing on each 3-day mean, by quarter of the mean's centre; vapour_above_reference by level top first (kg/m2). against_cm1: means on PlaSim's full levels, top first, rh by PlaSim's saturation; CM1's night interpolated in log pressure (level) and as layer means by mass (layer). plumes: the plume above, pseudo-adiabatic, from PlaSim's lowest level through each mean column laid on CM1's levels, against the scheme's top on the same column.
